results.title: TC-GEO-1267-001 - Concept detail panel shows frequency and the polarity label with no sentiment score

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of brand analysis B
steps.expected: The Top Concepts list is displayed
steps.observed: B = Toyota (439acd96), Overview, default filters. Card "Top Topics Associated with Your Brand" displayed with 31 rows (28 Positive, 1 Mixed, 2 Negative).

steps.title: When the user clicks the row of a Positive concept
steps.expected: The concept detail panel opens with a coloured header showing the concept name and the close button
steps.observed: Panel closed first (0 panel), then click on row "fiabilité" (Positive) -> panel opens: green header rgb(5,150,105) with h4 "fiabilité" and button aria-label "Close detail panel".

steps.title: Then the header shows the frequency and the polarity label
steps.expected: The header reads "{f}% frequency • Positive", "Positive" in a white pill (e.g. "90% frequency • Positive")
steps.observed: Header reads "45% frequency • Positive"; "Positive" is a rounded-full pill, background rgb(255,255,255), text emerald-700.

steps.title: And no sentiment score is shown in the panel
steps.expected: No -100 to +100 value and no "{score} sentiment" text (e.g. "-80 sentiment", "+80 sentiment") is shown anywhere in the panel
steps.observed: Panel text: 0 signed number, 0 occurrence of "sentiment".

steps.title: And the panel frequency matches the clicked row
steps.expected: The frequency % in the header equals the frequency % of the row of P
steps.observed: Row "fiabilité | 88 sources • Positive | 45%" = header "45% frequency".

results.notes: Panel = inline detail panel to the right of the list (testids dashboard-concept-detail-polarity-label, dashboard-concept-sources-section). Sources section shows 4 items + "All sources 88" (= row 88 sources).
